question: Does the existing TimesFM electricity-positive hybrid response depend on residual-specific normalization and its inverse?

design.stage: PREPARED; HOLD native until explicit new slot grant
design.question: Does the existing TimesFM electricity-positive hybrid response depend on residual-specific normalization and its inverse?
design.cohort: All64 existing electricity main-origin sources from natural_validation_replication4955000, ranks72..135, origin256;29 accepted tones,35 abstentions. No other domain, hindcast selection or new data.
design.evidence_class: Descriptive causal-path intervention on already-seen cohort; not fresh confirmation
design.intervention: Reuse unmodified native code and coherence_study.normalization: joint forward/inverse full-history background lock; ordinary context is nullcontext. Same saved FP32 full/residual inputs and fixed depth1 future tones.
design.gates: All64 exact locked-full self identities and ordinary-full repeats;29 exact locked residual repeats;35 exact abstentions; helper restoration every context. Bolt64 post-exit full repeats; TF64 internal anchor-capture repeats plus8 post-exit full repeats.
design.old_batch4: NOT an exact gate. Always save per-source max absolute, relativeLinf with max(1,absolute forecast) scale, pointwise relative floor1e-12, RMS and differing-element counts. Never call nonzero differences equivalent or assume roundoff. Current contrasts use fresh batch1 arms exclusively.
design.drift_bound: For each old/new source forecast, absolute MSE drift <=2*sqrt(old MSE)*RMS(new-old)+RMS(new-old)^2. Sum native/hybrid bounds to bound gain drift; report actual old/new gains and any sign changes without selection.
design.primary: Per model paired64-source locked hybrid versus ordinary hybrid and versus native; ordinary hybrid versus native retained to reassess old positive at batch1.
design.loss: Mean32 squared error on ALREADY own-history-standardized saved forecasts/targets. Do not renormalize. Equal source weight; all64 retained including ties/abstentions.

bootstrap.kind: descriptive paired64-source percentile95%; shared indices across models and contrasts

design.partition: Same saved history-frequency sine/cos QR plane, original128-step units on32-step horizon. Unmodified future errors only; no future-selected basis or prediction modification. Exactzero abstentions.
limitations: Reused cohort and old positive: no fresh confirmation or new significance claim. Electricity sources may share weather/calendar/system effects.
Joint forward/inverse intervention is normalizer-mediated response, not a training diagnosis; it changes relative dynamic range and cannot separate forward versus inverse contributions.
Native outputs are medians, not means. Geometric plane is not true-component decomposition. Cached data pretraining overlap remains unknown.
design.estimate: Weather lock144 Bolt calls23.47093s and174 TF calls37.31433s; current279/287 estimated<90s each. Hard300s/model;CPU1;RSS3GiB;one native worker at a time.

exact_findings.status: Both captures valid; slot2 released before analysis
